item.title: Medicare revokes Houston company's billing after 13 Investigates unrecognized charges
item.description: Medicare will no longer allow a Houston-based company to bill it after 13 Investigates heard from residents with charges on their accounts that they didn't recognize.

item.title: The connection between drought and wildfire risk in southeast Texas, when to be on alert
item.description: The risk of wildfire in southeast Texas increases as our current drought conditions are paired with gusty winds and low humidity.

item.title: Houston ISD trustees to make final decision on closing 12 schools
item.description: Houston ISD officials are expected to finalize plans on Thursday to close 12 schools in the district.

item.title: Are corporate buyers boxing out families from buying single-family homes in Harris County?
item.description: President Trump thrust Houston's housing market into the national spotlight during the State of the Union, saying investment companies are preventing families from buying homes.

item.title: Online sale meet-up leads to shooting in Fifth Ward that left man critically injured, HPD says
item.description: Houston police said they responded to a shooting scene in the Fifth Ward that allegedly stemmed from an online sale meet-up gone wrong.

item.title: US child, teen obesity rates reach record high while adult trends appear to slow, CDC report finds
item.description: U.S. childhood and teen obesity rates have reached record-highs while adult obesity rates may be slowing, according to two new reports published early Wednesday by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

item.title: Investigation underway after woman found dead at Spring Branch apartment complex, police say
item.description: Investigators say they're not sure how the woman died, but say she had contusions on her head.

item.title: Audit says Harris County Sheriff's Office not following state law, thousands owed to former inmates
item.description: A new audit found the Harris County Sheriff's Office is not following state law.

item.title: Former NASA engineer sues City of Houston, sex assault accusers after charges dismissed
item.description: A former NASA engineer has filed a federal lawsuit against four women who accused him of sexual assault, as well as the City of Houston and two Houston police detectives.

item.title: Met Gala reveals 2026 dress code: 'Fashion is Art'
item.description: The dress code for the 2026 gala is "Fashion is Art," according to Vogue.
